Two FDs: noise TKFDSMA85003 (Rs 2,98,000, label 'TK Premium FD', start 2026-05-10, listed FIRST) and correct TKFDSMA85002 (Rs 3,00,000, label 'TK Regular FD', start 2026-02-15, listed SECOND). CORRECT TKFDSMA85002 (Rs 3,00,000, 6.5%, label 'TK Regular FD', start 2026-02-15, 6 months run, listed SECOND). Amounts differ by ~0.7%. Labels differ by one distinguishing word. Maturity correct: 300000 x (1+6.5/400)^12 = 364110 (same factor as fd_close_identical_trap.001). Maturity noise: 298000 x (1+6.5/400)^8 ~ 298000 x 1.1376 = 339010.

get_deposit_closure_quote._comment: CORRECT FD (TKFDSMA85002, Feb 15 start, 6 months run): step-down to 6.0%. Accrued: 300000 x 6.0% x 6/12 = 9000. Penalty 1% = 3000. Payout: 300000+9000-3000 = 306000, effective 4.0%. NOISE FD (TKFDSMA85003, May 10 start, 3 months run): step-down to 5.0%. Accrued: 298000 x 5.0% x 3/12 = 3725. Penalty 1% = 2980. Payout: 298000+3725-2980 = 298745, effective 1.0%.
